# PCBWay Fabrication and Assembly

Curated by Skill Harbor: the second fabrication skill in the KiCad collection, and the alternative to JLCPCB when global sourcing matters. Where JLCPCB assembly leans on the LCSC parts library, PCBWay turnkey assembly sources parts by manufacturer part number from anywhere, which makes it the choice when parts are not available on LCSC, or when an assembly needs components sourced globally rather than from LCSC only. It covers turnkey and consigned assembly options, the BOM format for assembly, PCBWay design rules and capabilities, assembly constraints, and the ordering workflow step by step. For Gerber export, stencil ordering and BOM management it points back to the bom skill in this batch rather than duplicating it. By @aklofas, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: this skill is a single SKILL.md with no references or scripts folder, so the install is just that file; the PCBWay partner API requires approval, so API ordering is not available to everyone by default; and fabrication and assembly cost real money, so review every order, quantities and files, before paying. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
